emails.subject_line_b: Austin roof financing calculator for Roof Royale
emails.body_text:
Hey Tony & Jessica,

I was looking through roofroyale.com and noticed you promote Roof Financing right in your top menu, but Austin homeowners still hit a static 8-field form with no way to see a ballpark cost or monthly payment first.

Most folks bounce rather than hand over their phone number blind.

So I built a working 30-second Roof & Financing Estimator in your black-and-gold Roof Royale branding. It shows Austin shingle, metal, and tile ranges plus monthly payments before asking for a name and number.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

Tangible Proof & Specificity (concrete Austin pricing math + interactive self-test on their own phone eliminates skepticism)

emails.subject_line_b: One small mobile fix on roofroyale.com
emails.body_text:
Hey Tony & Jessica,

Quick note in case you thought that estimator required a website redesign — it doesn't.

It drops onto roofroyale.com with one line of code in 5 minutes, stays isolated from your existing styling, and weighs less than a single photo (28 KB).

Bonus heads-up for your web team: roofroyale.com currently sets maximum-scale=1 in its mobile viewport tag, which blocks pinch-to-zoom on phones and dings mobile UX scores. Easy 10-second fix either way.

Want me to walk you through how it plugs into your CRM?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: We already have a website guy / marketing agency.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: That's actually ideal — we don't replace your agency or redesign roofroyale.com. This is a single 28 KB drop-in script tag your web guy can paste onto your homepage and financing page in 5 minutes. It simply turns the traffic your agency already brings in into 2x–3x more qualified inspection bookings.

objection_handlers.objection: We can't quote roofs accurately online — every roof has hidden decking, valleys, or code issues.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree, and this tool never gives a binding bid. It gives an honest Central Texas ballpark range with a clear on-site confirmation disclaimer so $5,000 tire-kickers filter themselves out before your Community Advisors roll a truck, while serious buyers arrive pre-educated on realistic $13k–$36k investment and financing options.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $950 setup + $199/mo when Roofr/Roofle exist or we could add a cheap form plugin?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Generic calculators slap third-party branding on your page and cost $150–$300+/mo anyway, while static form plugins don't show pricing or financing at all. Ours is 100% white-labeled in Roof Royale's black-and-gold identity, routes every lead's sq. ft., pitch, material, and storm flag straight to your CRM/SMS, includes quarterly pricing updates across all five of your Texas markets, and a single closed Austin roof replacement pays for the tool for over four years.

objection_handlers.objection: We're slammed right now with storm calls and crews — bad time to add tech.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Storm surges are actually when this pays off fastest. Instead of your office manually sorting active leaks and hail claims from routine shoppers, the widget tags storm/leak urgency automatically and puts them into your ASAP slot. You don't lift a finger — one 10-minute review of your pricing ranges, and we hand your web team the single script line.

objection_handlers.objection: Will adding a calculator slow down our website or mess up our mobile design?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero chance. It's pure vanilla JavaScript (28 KB total, 8.8 KB gzipped — smaller than a single roof photo) wrapped in Shadow DOM isolation, so it cannot touch or break a single pixel of roofroyale.com's layout. Plus we'll send your team the 1-line fix for your current maximum-scale=1 mobile zoom tag for free.

objection_handlers.objection: Just email me the pricing and let me think about it.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Happy to — I'll send a 3-bullet recap ($950 one-time calibration & install, $199/mo for hosting, CRM/SMS routing, and quarterly Texas price updates, cancel anytime) along with the live link so you and Jessica can test it on your phones. Mind if I check back in Thursday morning for a quick yes or no?
